prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE NEW UPWARD ROUND SPIRAL STAIRCASE terrain sprite for an old-school32x32 pixel roguelike. IMAGE1 is DCSS reference for pixel texture, small scale and clear raised steps. IMAGE2 is the approved ROUND DOWN staircase from this project: match its grey stone/concrete material and visual family, but create the UP staircase counterpart. Subject must truly be a spiral stair: five substantial wedge treads attached to a SMALL SHORT central cylindrical core, winding around it and gradually RISING, with a small highest tread/landing toward upper-left and lowest entry toward lower-right. Show enough shaded vertical risers and outer stepped profile that it reads UP at actual32px. The top center is solid grey core, NOT a black hole. Compact nearly circular footprint with slight C-shaped opening at the entry. Keep treads wide and connected; NOT a flat fan, seashell, flower, turbine, concentric rings, rounded straight4step flight or ornamental sculpture. No giant pedestal, no tall tower, no high column. Slight overhead/side elevation like original Crawl, a squat modest stair, not dramatic modern perspective. Surface: worn matte mid-grey cement, irregular sparse pixel speckle, dark undersides at the base blending with a grey street; narrow muted highlights, NO continuous bright white outline on every tread, no smooth glossy faces. Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, logical32x32 sprite, around8 shades. Grey midtones #555754, shaded risers #303332, highest tread #7d8178, darkest contact pixels #202323. No handrails, no fences, no doorway, no roof, no surrounding floor square, no text, no symbol, no cast shadow outside sprite. TRUE TRANSPARENT background outside sprite and through openings. Single compact object filling square canvas with minimal margin. Prioritize readable stairs and a humble game terrain look over decorative detail.
